svg.title: Fuse compared with dotnet build and dotnet test (fuse.codes)
svg.desc: Fuse, a faster .NET build and test loop for AI coding agents (fuse.codes, github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse). Check an edit, fuse check against dotnet build. FluentValidation (4 projects): 0.38 seconds with Fuse, 2.25 seconds with dotnet, 5.9x faster at the median; Fuse 0.15 to 14.6 s, mean 1.01 s, P95 2.77 s; dotnet 1.48 to 8.82 s, mean 2.94 s, P95 7.35 s; NodaTime (15 projects): 0.70 seconds with Fuse, 3.67 seconds with dotnet, 5.3x faster at the median; Fuse 0.08 to 15.3 s, mean 1.75 s, P95 8.62 s; dotnet 1.86 to 11.4 s, mean 4.38 s, P95 9.87 s; Jellyfin (40 projects): 0.47 seconds with Fuse, 20.8 seconds with dotnet, 44.4x faster at the median; Fuse 0.11 to 76.9 s, mean 6.00 s, P95 34.0 s; dotnet 3.34 to 93.9 s, mean 28.7 s, P95 87.4 s; Polly (15 projects): 2.83 seconds with Fuse, 21.0 seconds with dotnet, 7.4x faster at the median; Fuse 0.58 to 43.5 s, mean 5.85 s, P95 21.4 s; dotnet 2.96 to 106.4 s, mean 35.9 s, P95 102.0 s. Run the affected tests, fuse test against dotnet test. FluentValidation (2,664 tests): 9.78 seconds with Fuse, 11.6 seconds with dotnet, 1.2x faster at the median; Fuse 7.89 to 37.9 s, mean 13.9 s, P95 37.9 s; dotnet 10.6 to 18.3 s, mean 13.1 s, P95 18.3 s; NodaTime (42,736 tests): 57.5 seconds with Fuse, 41.9 seconds with dotnet, 1.4x slower at the median; Fuse 0.09 to 113.3 s, mean 54.5 s, P95 113.3 s; dotnet 32.6 to 64.4 s, mean 46.3 s, P95 64.4 s; Jellyfin (2,535 tests): 98.4 seconds with Fuse, 164.1 seconds with dotnet, 1.7x faster at the median; Fuse 4.70 to 149.1 s, mean 98.0 s, P95 149.1 s; dotnet 138.2 to 180.1 s, mean 162.9 s, P95 180.1 s; Polly (12,329 tests): 26.2 seconds with Fuse, 114.1 seconds with dotnet, 4.4x faster at the median; Fuse 0.09 to 100.9 s, mean 27.5 s, P95 100.9 s; dotnet 99.9 to 150.1 s, mean 116.8 s, P95 150.1 s. Check on a warm engine, fuse check, P50 / P95 over the edits of each kind. FluentValidation: Body edit 366 / 485 ms, Signature edit 3,413 / 17,609 ms, Nothing changed, P50 38 ms; NodaTime: Body edit 816 / 1,121 ms, Signature edit 3,939 / 15,680 ms, Nothing changed, P50 38 ms; Jellyfin: Body edit 142 / 2,501 ms, Signature edit 60 / 64,867 ms, Nothing changed, P50 30 ms; Polly: Body edit 281 / 792 ms, Signature edit 712 / 9,617 ms, Nothing changed, P50 50 ms. Accuracy against the real build and test run, Counted against dotnet build and dotnet test on the same edits. FluentValidation: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 8 changes; NodaTime: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 7 changes; Jellyfin: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 2 changes; Polly: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 6 changes. Engine memory, Working set of the engine process. FluentValidation: After the checks 727 MB, Peak 727 MB, Idle 479 MB; NodaTime: After the checks 352 MB, Peak 835 MB, Idle 350 MB; Jellyfin: After the checks 520 MB, Peak 1,143 MB, Idle 464 MB; Polly: After the checks 732 MB, Peak 1,463 MB, Idle 714 MB. Median times over the eval cases, each with the range from the fastest to the slowest case, the mean and P95, on GitHub Actions windows-latest runners.
